Initial public release of "yotta-security-testing":

- Introduces a disciplined AI methodology for Web security testing in four phases: Reconnaissance, Discovery, Verification, and Reporting.
- Enforces "Scope Guard" with five mandatory safeguards to ensure all activity is within authorized scope (via scope.json) and fully auditable.
- Supports asset authorization management, security testing report generation, and activity logging out-of-the-box with Python 3.8+ standard library.
- Covers common web vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, XXE, etc.), with playbooks mapped to OWASP Top 10 and report templates for both training and real bug bounty/SRC scenarios.
- Never outputs executable payloads; strictly refuses unauthorized or illegal targets by default.
- Free and open source (MIT), with zero dependencies.
